preconditions.description: The size of the array arr is between 1 and 20,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 10 for s in arr)
preconditions.description: Each string in arr has a length between 1 and 10.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (any(arr[i] + arr[j] == (arr[i] + arr[j])[::-1] for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j))
postconditions.description: The function returns true if there exists a pair of strings arr[i] and arr[j] such that their concatenation is a palindrome, otherwise false.
